I’ve heard that when reservation codes are tied to the same passenger profile you don’t have to jump through extra hoops, since LU15PA seems to be unavailable to pull up right now anyway. I’ve got confirmation emails for LU15PA and MSJ4OA sitting in my inbox from when I booked those trips back in March, each with the full itinerary and seat selection I picked at checkout.

results.last_text: Hey, quick side note before I get to my flight stuff— I was on the tarmac earlier waiting to deplane and saw the cutest little golden retriever puppy in a carrier under the seat two rows ahead of me, he kept poking his nose out to beg for pretzels from the person sitting next to him, and I swear he even waved his little paw at the flight attendant when she walked by with the drink cart. Oh, and also I noticed the airport coffee shop by gate B17 is selling those lavender honey lattes I used to get on my work trips to Portland last year, I might grab one after I sort this out. Anyway, I need to cancel a couple of my upcoming reservations: first, I know the confirmation code LU15PA is for the flight I was gonna take to visit my sister next month, wait, actually since that reservation I booked back in March seems to be completely unavailable in your system right now, just go ahead and cancel the one under code LU16PA instead, yeah? And then also cancel the reservation under code MSJ4OA for the work trip I was supposed to take to Dallas at the end of the quarter. Wait, no, hold on—can you also make sure the cancellation for that work trip gets applied to the booking that has my pre-paid checked bag and extra legroom seat attached to it? Yeah, that’s all, thanks.

I was waiting in the airport coffee shop earlier and watched a sparrow fly in through the automatic doors, steal a whole blueberry muffin off a traveler’s tray, and perch on the departures board pecking crumbs while everyone laughed and took videos. The barista said that same sparrow has been sneaking in for pastries for three weeks straight, and none of the staff have managed to shoo it out for more than ten minutes at a time. I also heard that the new pre-made turkey wraps they started selling last week have way too much Dijon mustard, and the charging station by gate B12 has two broken USB ports that haven’t been fixed since last month. I’ve got three reservations on my account right now, one under code LU15PZ that I was looking over earlier, another under code MSJ4OA, and I remember there’s a third one tied to my upcoming trip to visit my cousin in Cleveland that I was going through last night when I was sorting my travel emails. A friend mentioned that sometimes when you’re sorting through upcoming travel plans, you might go through old bookings you don’t need anymore to clear out your account dashboard.

I swear the airport Cinnabon line was so long this morning I almost missed my connecting bus to the rental car center, and the barista at the coffee kiosk next to it gave me oat milk instead of the whole milk I asked for in my latte, plus my travel neck pillow started leaking those tiny microbeads all over my backpack the second I sat down on the train to the terminal. Ugh, I also remember I booked these tickets right after my friend told me about that terrible seafood place near the beach we were supposed to visit, so that whole plan’s already fallen through anyway. Can you please cancel the reservations under confirmation codes 8C8K4E and MSJ4OA? Wait, no, hold on—wait, that third code, I had it written down somewhere… oh right, no, actually the last one is MSK4OA, yeah, that’s what it says on my old confirmation screenshot I just pulled up. Wait, no, I don’t need to change seats or add bags or anything, just get those cancellations processed for me please, and don’t worry about sending a separate text alert, my email’s already on file.

results.query: I spent all last weekend helping my neighbor rescue three baby squirrels that fell out of the oak tree in their front yard, we fed them warm formula every two hours and even lined a cardboard box with old fleece blankets from my college dorm, I heard the local wildlife rehab center is taking them in tomorrow once they’re stable enough to move. Oh, and I remembered I brought a crumpled pack of lemon drops in my carry-on for the last work trip I took back in March, the ones my grandma always keeps in her purse for long car rides, I still have the half-empty pack tucked in the side pocket of my suitcase. I’ve got three reservations under my name, one with the confirmation code 8C8K4E, another with the confirmation code LU15PA, and a third one that I booked when I thought I’d have to extend my work trip by a week, the one I paid for using the travel credit I got when that flight to Cleveland got delayed three hours last winter. I’ve heard the airline’s system lets people sort out stuff with existing bookings really smoothly if they have the right confirmation details on hand, no long hold times or messy paperwork to fill out.
